rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Related media type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to an official two-part identifier for file formats and format contents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Synonym
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Words or expressions used in the same language that have the same or nearly the same meaning in some or all senses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Description
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Longer statement or account giving the characteristics of someone or something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Word or phrase that constitutes the distinctive designation of a being or thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Content type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured information on the content type of a file instance, bundle or repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Detailed and precise presentation of, or proposal for something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: File extension
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: String of characters attached as suffix to the names of files of a particular format.
